CHAPTER 2

Zion’s Future Glory and the Day of Jehovah

1. The glories in the latter days (Isaiah 2:1-4) 2. Exhortation to walk in the light (Isaiah 2:5) 3. The corruption of the people (Isaiah 2:6-9) 4. The day of Jehovah (Isaiah 2:10-22) The vision of verses 1-4 is altogether future. When Israel is converted and in possession of the land, when once more a house of Jehovah will stand in Israel’s land, then this great prediction will be fulfilled. Compare withMicah 4:1-55. The Day of the Lord (Jehovah) is the day of His visible manifestation to deal with the earth in judgment. Compare with Isaiah 24:1-23, etc.,Zephaniah 1:1-18.
